breakdown.description: Gamma-centered k-point sampling conflicts with a half-shifted Monkhorst-Pack mesh.
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt incorrectly specified 'an automatic Monkhorst-Pack grid with a half shift' alongside a gamma-centered grid, which is contradictory. The generated specification correctly uses only gamma-centered k-point grids (6x6x6 for vc-relax/scf and 12x12x12 for nscf) without any mention of a half-shifted Monkhorst-Pack mesh, aligning with the ground truth which simply states 'Use a gamma-centered k-point grid.'
